title: The published atlas engine at campaign settings on public 10x data (Research Alpha)
dataset_scope: 7 public 10x datasets re-run with the campaign binary (v0.3.0, 8e1803ba) at the campaign settings: first 30M read pairs, --threads 4 --pipeline --output-format 1pz, human flags; this is how every Alpha sample was made

tools.name: singlet
tools.params: singlet-alpha-8e1803b: head 30M read pairs -> singlet encode -> singlet --threads 4 --pipeline --output-format 1pz (+ --snps --cascade auto --txome-index --te-classify on --te-db for human); cell calls = STARsolo CellRanger2.2 knee

tools.name: starsolo
tools.params: all reads; CB_UMI_Simple, --soloFeatures Gene GeneFull Velocyto --soloCellFilter EmptyDrops_CR --soloUMIdedup 1MM_CR --soloUMIfiltering MultiGeneUMI_CR --clipAdapterType CellRanger4 --outFilterScoreMin 30

tools.name: starsolo-thinning-noise-floor
tools.params: two independent binomial thinnings of STARsolo Gene per cell to the shared depth

tools.name: adt-clusters
tools.params: Leiden clusters of CLR-normalised ADT counts (published Cell Ranger h5)

conclusion: Re-run exactly as the atlas was made (campaign binary, first 30M reads, 4 threads) on 7 public 10x datasets, Singlet recovers 80%-98% of 10x's published cells, against STARsolo EmptyDrops_CR on all reads. See metrics for counts, the barnyard and CITE-seq truth, and the 5' strand failure.
methods: Seven public 10x datasets of the pipeline benchmark (docs/pipeline-validation.md 3) were re-run with the binary every Alpha sample reports (git 8e1803ba, v0.3.0-pilot-freeze), rebuilt with the benchmark's build patches, at the campaign settings of cellarium full_campaign/run_one.sbatch: the first 30M read pairs (head of the lane-sorted FASTQs, as `download --max-reads 30000000` keeps the head of a run), `--threads 4 --pipeline --output-format 1pz` and, for human, `--snps --cascade auto --txome-index --te-classify on --te-db`. STARsolo (Cell Ranger 4 emulation, EmptyDrops_CR) and 10x's published Cell Ranger matrices use all reads. Scoring reuses bench/pipeline/analysis (loaders, gene_concordance, barnyard, ADT clusters): calls vs published Cell Ranger; on cells called by Singlet and STARsolo, exonic UMIs per cell vs STARsolo Gene, per-cell log1p correlation after thinning both to half the smaller total (noise floor: two thinnings of STARsolo); barnyard purity on called cells; ARI of RNA vs ADT clusters.
caveats: The 30M-read head of lane-sorted demo FASTQs stands in for the head of an SRA run; read order inside SRA runs can differ.
hgmm1k_v3 needed 120 GB (it was killed at the campaign's 64 GB); the campaign escalated memory per attempt in the same way.
10x's published matrices are Cell Ranger 2-3 on an older reference; STARsolo uses the campaign reference.
pbmc5p_v1 is the first 60M read pairs of the dataset, so the 30M cap is half of the benchmark input, not of the full library.
